name: Vulpyre
concept: (existing starter)
visual: (existing art)

name: Blazethorn
concept: The final form of the starter Vulpyre: a proud, sleek fire-fox whose mane erupts into a blazing crown of tall flame-spines, channelling its hearth-bond into devastating focused special blasts.
visual: Upright fox silhouette, deep ember-red coat, cream underbelly, mane erupting upward in a spike-crown of orange-to-white flames; regal and fast at 64px.
signature_idea: Crown Blaze — channelled fire beam boosted by bond strength; Blazethorn exclusive
hook: The Vulpyre you picked as a tiny cub grew into this gorgeous, powerful guardian — the payoff of your whole journey together.

name: Brinix
concept: The starter Tide kin — a stoic crested water-shelled kin that shields its allies with briny resilience. Already has art; this entry just anchors it in the line schema.
visual: Existing art (see assets/creatures/002_brinix/). Compact crested water-shelled body, seafoam palette, bold silhouette.
hook: The trusty starter — reliable, stoic, and grows into something formidable.

name: Brinarch
concept: Brinix's final kindled form. The brine-crest has broadened into a sweeping crown of sea-glass plating; its bulk and endurance are legendary on the southern coast. Becomes the region's apex defender.
visual: Tall, broad-shouldered, slate-blue shell plating crested with sea-glass spurs in translucent teal. Wide stance, deep chest, a calm but commanding gaze behind a brow-ridge. Dual water-crystal shoulder guards.
signature_idea: Brine Bulwark — sets a tide-flavoured reflect that scales with HP remaining
hook: The satisfying payoff of raising your starter — a true coastal fortress on the field.

name: Wicklit
concept: A matchstick sprite, barely the height of a thumb, that ignites itself to draw attention away from endangered kin, then safely regrows its wax body overnight.
visual: Thin matchstick body of pale cream wax, a spherical amber head topped by a single tiny flame-tuft; two twig-thin arms; big worried eyes; small enough to balance on a coin at 16px.
hook: It sacrifices its own flame to protect others — children love a scrappy little helper with a big heart.

name: Wickmere
concept: A half-grown candle-folk that has learned to shape its wax body mid-battle, flowing around attacks and re-forming with a warm laugh, frustrating physical hitters.
visual: Slender humanoid of ivory wax, three flames now crowning its head like a candelabra; half-melted wax drapes off shoulders like a cape; cheerful smiling face; rounded candle-base feet; reads clearly at 32px.
signature_idea: Soft Wax — when hit by a physical move, has a 30% chance to reduce the attacker's Attack by one stage (wax clings and slows).
hook: The three-flame crown is immediately distinctive and memorable on a team roster.

name: Wicklord
concept: A regal candelabra-kin whose body is a flowing pillar of warm wax lined with seven blazing wicks; it calms storms of fear and darkness with a steady, generous light that seems to make everyone in range feel safer.
visual: Tall, dignified humanoid; torso is a layered tiered candelabra of poured wax, seven distinct flames each a different warm hue from amber to rose; long draping arms of flowing wax; a composed, kind face half-shadowed by a wax-brim hat; strikes a warm silhouette at 48px.
signature_idea: Seven Wicks — activates Reflect AND Light Screen simultaneously at reduced duration (3 turns each), at the cost of the user's next action.
hook: The seven-flame crown doubles as a personality — each flame flickers differently; players will call it iconic.

name: Glimflit
concept: A tiny firefly-sprite that bobs through Tinderwick's evening air, its tail-lantern blinking in rhythmic code only other Glimflit can read.
visual: Transparent-winged insectoid sprite, thumbnail-sized; round mint-green body, a single amber bead tail-lamp that pulses on and off; long antennae tipped with spark-dots; silhouette reads as a floating comma at 16px.
signature_idea: Beacon Blink — switches itself and one ally's positions, also removing one entry hazard from the target's side.
hook: It blinks at you with a friendly rhythm — kids will try to tap along.

name: Glimscout
concept: A grown firefly-courier that blazes a trail of lingering glow-motes wherever it streaks, marking safe paths through the dusk for those who follow.
visual: Elongated, dragonfly-like frame; four layered wings edged with cyan; abdomen striped amber and cream, tip blazing a permanent steady beacon; big compound eyes catching every glint; reads as a streak of light at 32px.
signature_idea: Trailblaze — sets a field effect for 5 turns that boosts ally Speed by one stage on entry and negates accuracy drops.
hook: It looks fast even when standing still — older players will immediately clock it as a pivot piece.

name: Tallowpup
concept: A stumpy wax-coated pup whose stubby tail is a flickering tallow candle that warms everything it curls against.
visual: Chunky cream-and-butter-yellow puppy body, ink nose, a single pale candle-flame tail with a soft wax drip; big round eyes; reads as one warm blob at 32px.
hook: The single candle-tail is irresistibly cute — kids will want to protect the little flame.

name: Tallowcrest
concept: A mid-sized candle-hound with a crown of five dripping tallow flames that shift colour depending on its mood.
visual: Robust tawny dog silhouette, wax-drip markings down the haunches, a starburst of five pastel-hued candle-flames crowning the head; distinct and bold at 48px.
hook: The mood-colour flames make it feel alive — a warm ally that visibly cares.

name: Chandrek
concept: A great candlewood hound whose entire mane is a cathedral of living candles, radiating warm golden light that soothes nearby kin.
visual: Large, dignified canine silhouette; back and mane bristle with tall tapers in cream, gold, and amber; pooling light halos the outline; dramatic yet soft at 64px.
signature_idea: Warm Vigil — buffs allies' Special Defense for two turns
hook: An apex hound made of living light — the kind of kin you want walking beside you in the dark.

name: Ashlette
concept: A tiny ash-fairy that drifts on warm updrafts, trailing grey motes; when it sneezes, it blasts a puff of concentrated fire-dust.
visual: Near-translucent teardrop fairy body in pale smoke-grey with a tiny ember core, gossamer ash-wings, two stub arms; minimal but charming at 32px.
hook: The sneeze that accidentally launches a fireball — endearingly powerful.

name: Embrift
concept: A swirling ash-sprite that has grown a permanent vortex of superheated cinders around its body, moving like a living dust-devil.
visual: Hovering humanoid silhouette ringed by a spinning debris-halo of cinders, orange core glowing at the heart, long wispy arms; dynamic at 48px.
hook: A tiny fairy has become a swirling pillar of flame — awe-inducing mid-stage transformation.

name: Pyriven
concept: A towering cinder-wraith whose body is a column of black smoke wreathed in fierce orange-white flames, haunting the ruins of old hearths.
visual: Tall ghostly pillar silhouette: smoke-black upper body fading into blazing fire-orange lower half, spectral arms, hollow bright eyes; striking contrast at 64px.
signature_idea: Charcoal Hex — special Dark move that also applies a burn
hook: The ash-fairy grew into a ghost made of fire — spooky, beautiful, and unforgettable.

name: Wickmoth
concept: A small ember-winged moth that navigates by following warm light and scorches anything it bumps into by accident.
visual: Tiny round fuzzy moth body in ash-grey, wings tipped in orange-to-yellow ember gradients, two long antennae with spark-dot tips; reads as a fluttering silhouette at 32px.
hook: The classic 'dangerous but clumsy' charm — a burny little moth you can't help but root for.

name: Scorchwing
concept: A magnificent ember-moth with broad, vein-lit wings that trail blazing filaments and leave a shower of sparks with every wingbeat.
visual: Wide, spread-wing moth silhouette; upper wings are deep charcoal laced with bright ember veins, lower wings trail glowing filaments; menacing and beautiful at 64px.
signature_idea: Flare Scatter — hits all opponents with low-power fire sparks
hook: From clumsy little Wickmoth to this gorgeous blazing terror — one of the most satisfying glow-ups in Vesperholm.

name: Hearthkit
concept: A small round hearth-fox kitten that nests inside unused fireplaces and glows soft amber when it purrs; it smells permanently of woodsmoke and cinnamon.
visual: Round-bodied kitten, deep apricot coat with cream markings, curled ember-glow tail, closed-eyed happy expression; warm and cosy silhouette at 32px.
hook: The kitten that lives in the fireplace and purrs — every kid wants one as a bedroom companion.

name: Warmantis
concept: The hearth-kitten has grown into a luminous fire-cat that forms a bond so deep it can project its warmth as a visible golden aura shielding its trainer.
visual: Elegant long-bodied cat silhouette, warm gold-and-cream coat, a soft luminous aura halo, ember-tip tail; graceful and glowing at 64px.
signature_idea: Hearth-Oath — dramatically raises ally's Defense and Sp.Defense for 3 turns; usable once per battle
hook: The bond evolution payoff — it literally becomes an aura of love around you.

name: Tidmote
concept: A tiny darting water-sprite that skims the sea surface, trailing a thread of moonlit water behind it. So fast it appears to teleport between waves.
visual: Tiny sprite, blue-white water droplet shape with trailing wisps, two pinpoint bright eyes, a single glowing ribbon-tail. Appears as a moving sparkle on water surfaces.
hook: The impossible-to-catch tiny speedster — Glintfin's spiritual counterpart that players spend hours trying to lamp.

name: Tidmaren
concept: The water-sprite is now a swift silver shape that dances between moonbeams, spreading brief distraction-glimmers to cover allies.
visual: Slim, elegant aquatic sprite — silver with pale moonlight-blue highlights, long streaming water-veil wings, a crescent-shaped luminous head-marking, twin ribbon tails.
signature_idea: Moonveil — applies an Evasion buff and a Light-type reflect-burst to adjacent ally
hook: The support speedster that doubles as a gorgeous visual — its moonveil makes other kin look good.

name: Tidwraith
concept: The fully kindled water-light sprite — now a ghostly shining figure of pure tide-light that moves faster than the eye can track.
visual: Tall, translucent humanoid sprite of flowing water and moonlight — silver-white with luminous aqua veins, streaming ribbon-limbs, a face of pure calm radiance, and a cascading tail of moon-foam.
signature_idea: Phantom Current — Tide/Light priority move; phases through Shields and barriers
hook: The transcendent final form of the tiniest starter — trainers who raise a Tidmote are rewarded with the coast's most ethereal kin.

name: Glintfin
concept: A small glinting schooling fish with a single prismatic scale that acts like a signal mirror. Groups of them communicate with flashes.
visual: Tiny silvery fish with oversized prism-scale fin fanning out like a tail-fan, blue-teal body, big friendly eye, subtle light-refracting markings.
hook: Cute little mirror-fish — the tutorial kin for Tide typing; appears in water as soon as the player gets Tidecall.

name: Shimmral
concept: The glintfin shoal has merged into a single larger fish with a spectacular prismatic fin-mantle. It blasts light-refractions as attack.
visual: Elegant mid-sized fish, iridescent blue-silver body, enormous fan-fin with rainbow diffraction pattern, graceful trailing fin-rays, bright intelligent eyes.
signature_idea: Prism Burst — high-power Light special move with a recoil-reduced spread effect
hook: The rainbow fin reveal mid-fight is a wow moment — fans debate the best name for the colour pattern.

name: Prismare
concept: The fully kindled form — a magnificent reef-fish whose entire body is a living prism. Light bends through it into weapons.
visual: Majestic, long-bodied fish with translucent crystalline fins that refract all light into dazzling arcs, pale blue-white body with thin crystalline armour plates, twin feeler-fins curled like antennae, piercing white eyes.
signature_idea: Wavelength — Tide/Light hybrid move that hits both types' super-effective targets
hook: The crystalline fish that turns any battlefield into a light show. Trainers use it for style points as much as power.

name: Brinelet
concept: A tiny round tidepool creature that rolls with the surf, collecting trinkets in a dimpled shell-belly. Scouts ahead with quick darting bursts.
visual: Plump oval body, translucent blue-grey with a pale underbelly, two bright bead eyes, stubby flipper-feet, and a dimpled concave belly-shell that catches pebbles and seaweed bits. Readable at 16px.
hook: Endearingly pudgy and curious — kids love how it collects bits of the beach in its belly-dip.

name: Brineroll
concept: Brinelet has grown a proper ridged shell and longer fins, tumbling through shallows with surprising speed. It spins to deflect attacks.
visual: Rounder, smoother armadillo-ish shell with tidal spiral ridges in seafoam-blue and cream. Wide webbed paddle-feet, curious antenna-stalks with glowing tips, bright confident eyes.
signature_idea: Tidecurl — a rolling physical move that gains speed-boost on use
hook: The satisfying glow-up from its wobbly baby form — it's fast now and knows it.

name: Brinewrath
concept: The line's final form — a sleek armoured tidal-beast that rides currents at high speed, its shell now a hydrodynamic shield. Commands entire tidal zones.
visual: Streamlined low-slung body, swept-back shell ridges like breaking waves, twin luminous teal eye-stalks, long trailing fin-limbs. Seafoam-blue and deep indigo palette, white crest markings.
signature_idea: Rip Current — priority move that also sets a Hazard on the field
hook: From beach-trinket collector to tidal apex — the full transformation arc hits hard at its reveal.

name: Glostern
concept: A small jellyfish-lantern drifting through Pearlmoor harbour. Its translucent bell glows with trapped moonlight, and it fires bioluminescent pulses at threats.
visual: Dome bell in soft aqua-blue with a warm gold luminescent core; four trailing tendril-ribbons with tiny pearl droplets at their tips, and a cluster of gentle light-spot eyes beneath the bell.
signature_idea: Pearl Pulse — special Light-attribute projectile that has a chance to blind
hook: A living lantern in the harbour — its gentle glow is the most iconic visual on the Pearlmoor loading screen.

name: Glostrael
concept: Glostern's kindled form — its bell has expanded enormously and its moon-glow fills the surrounding sea. A moving constellation-lantern.
visual: Vast translucent bell filled with golden light that fractures like stained glass, eight long trailing tentacles tipped with bright orbs like low-hanging stars. Deep navy outer bell, blazing gold interior.
signature_idea: Stellar Cascade — multi-hit Light/Tide combo that lowers target's Spd
hook: The biggest visual surprise on the southern coast — seeing one rise out of the harbour is awe-inspiring.

name: Lumpin
concept: A limpet-kin whose flat shell glows with stored moonlight. It clings to coastal rocks and pulses a gentle beacon to guide lost kin home.
visual: Conical shell in deep blue-grey with a soft gold radiant glow from within; plump body underneath, two wide-set gentle eyes, four tiny suction-tipped feet. Bioluminescent ring pattern on shell rim.
signature_idea: Shell Glow — boosts own Special Defence and applies a mild dazzle to attacker
hook: A cosy little lighthouse-limpet — kids want one as a nightlight companion.

name: Lumplass
concept: Lumpin's shell has fused into a radiant broad disc; it now clings to sea-cliff faces and projects a beam of moonlit brine-light that disrupts approaching attackers.
visual: Wide flat disc-shell patterned with concentric gold-and-aqua rings, textured like hammered moonstone. The creature beneath is plump and soft-looking with a single large circular eye at the shell's centre aperture.
signature_idea: Moonglass Barrier — sets a Light-screen equivalent that also prevents stat-lowering moves from landing
hook: A gorgeous, bizarre disc-creature — its single-eye silhouette is instantly iconic.

name: Embralux
concept: An apex Ember/Light candidate for the south region's secret Lumenary approach — a great phoenix-fox that embodies the moment between ember and starlight: the exact colour temperature where a flame is indistinguishable from a star. It inhabits the warm updraft columns around Tinderwick's lighthouse and has been spotted ascending and descending from the direction of the Ember constellation for generations. Some star-tenders believe it is a messenger between the anchor-kin and the constellation itself — the light-courier of the south sky.
visual: Sleek, long-limbed fox with enormous flame-and-star-ray tail plumes that trail behind it like a comet's tail. The body is amber-to-white radiant, as though lit from inside. The plume-tails shift between ember-orange at the base and cool diamond-cyan at the feathered tips — the gradient between fire and starlight. The ears are long and spark-tipped. The 64px sprite will look like a running star.
signature_idea: Ember Ascent — a rising strike that deals Ember damage on the way up and Light damage on the way down as the attack arc completes; triggers both STAB bonuses if the user holds both types, and always sets a Radiance field on landing.
hook: The fox that is also a comet. For players who fell in love with the south region's warmth and wanted an apex that belongs entirely to that feeling.

name: Tideveil
concept: The Tide Constellation Warden — a vast, semi-transparent sea-spirit that dwells in the Tideglass Cavern landmark. When Reyl relights the Tide constellation, Tideveil surfaces to confirm the pact. It is the living embodiment of the moonlit sea.
visual: Enormous translucent whale-like form, body almost entirely composed of moon-on-water refraction — shifting aqua, silver, and pale gold layers visible within. No hard edges, no single colour — a living sea-mirror. Two vast luminous crescent eyes and trailing aurora-thread fins.
signature_idea: Tidal Crown — once per battle, raises all Tide-type kin's stats by one stage; cancels the opponent's weather/terrain effects
hook: The constellation kin of the sea — seeing it surface in the Cavern is the south coast's defining awe moment.

name: Crystink
concept: A small crystal-beetle whose wing-cases are faceted like cut gems; it scurries through the Crystoll Vault tunnels collecting fragments of pure diamond crystal to patch its growing shell.
visual: Beetle-form about the size of a thumb; transparent faceted wing-cases filled with cyan-white crystal shards that catch light; six iridescent legs; eyes are tiny perfect gem-spheres in deep blue.
hook: The crystal beetle that collects gems for its own shell — adorable self-improvement.

name: Lumecite
concept: A radiant crystal-stag whose antlers are grown entirely from pure luminous diamond crystal; it illuminates entire mine chambers as it walks, and its light is said to repel the Hollowing.
visual: Elegant deer-like kin with a white-grey crystal body; antlers are an elaborate branching structure of cyan-diamond crystal that glow continuously; eyes are large and clear as water; hooves are polished white stone; beautiful and otherworldly.
hook: The crystal-antlered stag lighting the dark mine — majestic and mysterious, every player wants to find it.

name: Prismara
concept: The apex Stone/Light crystal kin of the Crystoll Vault — a towering crystal-stag whose entire body is now fused into a living prism; it refracts all light into a full spectrum and its presence causes crystal growths to bloom across the cave walls. The Stone Constellation Warden.
visual: Grand stag-form; body is smooth translucent white crystal shot through with a continuous rainbow refraction; diamond-branching antlers reach nearly to cave ceilings; four crystal-column legs; eyes emit soft white radiance; when still it is indistinguishable from a perfect crystal formation.
signature_idea: Prismatic Cascade — refracts stored light into a multi-hit special barrage that hits all types neutrally but with devastating power; lights up the battlefield for several turns.
hook: The Crystoll Vault's secret — the most spectacular kin in the eastern region and a genuine jaw-drop moment.

name: Mossglow
concept: A fuzzy moss-ball that slowly rolls through the forest floor of Lowleaf Hollow, leaving a trail of faint bioluminescent spores; too round and soft to be scary but deeply easy to underestimate.
visual: Near-perfect sphere of dense green moss with scattered amber spore-dots; no obvious limbs but two tiny leaf-stubs; a single sleepy eye peeking out from the moss; rolls via a wobble-wiggle motion; reads as a mossy marble at 16px.
hook: It looks completely harmless — players discover that its spore cloud inflicts Sleep, which is a lovely reveal.

name: Mossmantle
concept: A half-formed moss-treeling that has grown a cloak of living bioluminescent fronds; when it opens its arms the spore cloud it releases can confuse or sedate an entire clearing.
visual: Short bipedal figure draped in a thick cape of glowing green moss-fronds; a wooden face-plate with amber eyes showing through the moss hood; stubby arms ending in leaf-fans; a round body hidden under the living mantle; warm and eerie at 32px.
hook: A walking haunted coat of moss — kids will love the idea of a kin that is basically a living cloak.

name: Lumenmoss
concept: An ancient moss-lord of the Hollow whose entire body is a cathedral of bioluminescent growth; it breathes out a spore-fog that coats opponents' scales and slows their movement, while healing allies who stand within its light.
visual: Huge bipedal form entirely cloaked in thick layered glowing moss-panels; a great antler-rack of twisted branches sprouting glowing spore-bulbs; a solemn carved-wood face deep within a moss-arch; radiates green-amber light in gentle pulses; awe-inspiring at 48px.
signature_idea: Sporemist Cathedral — poisons all foes with a lingering light-spore variant (Glowblight: takes 1/8 HP each turn + -1 Speed) while curing all allied status ailments.
hook: A creature that IS a living forest shrine — kids who love Verdant AND Light kin will feel this is made for them.

name: Scorchite
concept: A marble-sized wandering coal-sprite with a single bright eye; it rolls into warm crevices in Cinderhead Mine and hums contentedly.
visual: Near-perfect sphere, dull black coal texture with a single amber-glow eye, two tiny round feet; the simplest possible round silhouette at 32px.
hook: The smallest, round-est creature in the mine — impossibly cute in its simplicity.

name: Coalump
concept: The little coal-sprite has absorbed enough heat to grow limbs and a second eye; its body now cracks open in starbursts of orange light when it attacks.
visual: Lumpy rounded torso, short sturdy limbs, two glowing eyes, body covered in expanding crack-pattern glow lines; reads as power building at 48px.
hook: Watching those cracks spread as it gets stronger makes every battle feel like building toward an explosion.

name: Pyrolith
concept: A crystallised magma-titan whose body has solidified into angular obsidian with a blazing reactor core visible through the translucent chest-plate.
visual: Tall imposing angular silhouette, jet obsidian faceted body, a glowing diamond-orange core blazing through a transparent chest section, jutting shoulder-spurs; monolithic at 64px.
signature_idea: Core Breach — massive single-hit fire blast; user loses some HP as recoil
hook: A tiny coal rolling in the dark became this godlike obsidian titan — the mine's final secret.

name: Flickore
concept: A small static-furred rodent whose iron-ore-flecked pelt crackles with friction sparks as it scurries through the tunnels. Base form of the Sparkrat line.
visual: Rat-sized, wiry body covered in dark iron-grey fur with tiny amber sparks visible along the spine; prominent rounded ears; long thin tail tipped with an ore nugget.
hook: The classic small cave rodent — but charged. Kids will love the sparking fur.

name: Sparkrat
concept: A larger, more confident ore-rodent whose entire coat is threaded with conductive mineral filaments; static discharge is constant and audible as a faint hiss. Canon Cinderhead Mine kin.
visual: Medium-sized stout rodent; fur is dark grey-black with arcing amber-white spark threads woven through it; black iron-ore patches on shoulders and haunches; tail has two ore-bead segments that clatter together.
hook: The sparking mine-rat everyone wants to catch; its crackling silhouette is instantly recognisable in the cave dark.

name: Voltcrag
concept: A large, heavily-built ore-beast that acts as a living conductor; veins of metallic mineral run visibly beneath its hide, and static builds in the mine walls around it.
visual: Bear-sized quadruped; charcoal-black stone-dense hide with bright amber charge-lines tracing the mineral veins; mane of stiff iron-ore bristles along the neck; tail a coiled ore-spring that arcs sparks when lashing.
signature_idea: Ore Discharge — a powerful Stone/Storm special move that chains between nearby metal-bearing surfaces for bonus damage in caves.
hook: The terrifying final form of the mine-rat — it's become a living storm-generator buried in stone.

name: Pebbit
concept: A round pebble-sprite no larger than a fist that clings to cave walls with adhesive stone-dust feet, bouncing away when startled.
visual: Almost perfectly spherical grey-brown body with two stub legs and wide amber eyes; tiny chip-marks on its shell like natural wear marks; silhouette reads as a rolling ball at 16px.
hook: Every kid will want to collect the round little pebble-thing first; it's adorable and bouncy.

name: Rubbol
concept: A stocky boulder-torso kin with a cracked surface revealing faint mineral veins; it rolls defensively when threatened.
visual: Squat, wide-shouldered stone body with visible grey-white mineral veins along arms; amber eyes now set in a craggy brow ridge; four sturdy legs planted firmly.
hook: The middle stage that looks like it means business — mineral veins hint at the spectacular final form.

name: Gravelo
concept: A broad, slow-moving tortoise whose domed shell is encrusted with genuine crystal growths from the mine, each facet catching the lamp-light differently. Canon Cinderhead Mine resident.
visual: Massive hexagonal-plated shell studded with diamond-crystal spires; four column-thick legs; small blunt head with half-lidded stone-grey eyes; walks with serene deliberateness; silhouette unmistakable at any size.
signature_idea: Crystal Rampart — raises Defense sharply while shedding crystal shards as a hazard.
hook: The iconic crystal-shelled tortoise of Cinderhead Mine; seeing it lumbering through the cave is an awe moment.

name: Fossik
concept: A small fossil-shrimp kin that has come back to life; its carapace is the hard chalk-white of ancient bone-stone and it navigates by vibrating its antennae against rock.
visual: Trilobite-like segmented body in pale bone-white chalk; two long swept-back antennae; multiple small legs; small eyes set in a wide flat head; delicate and prehistoric in feel.
hook: The little fossil come to life — ancient and delicate, like holding deep time.

name: Crevasser
concept: A revived fossil-crustacean that has grown larger and harder; its shell now has genuine crevasse-deep ridges and it moves along cave floors with quiet authority.
visual: Larger segmented crustacean; thick ridged carapace in layered grey-cream; heavy claws useful for gripping rock; wide eyes set at the edge of its head-plate; moves with a side-to-side deliberate walk.
hook: The fossil mid-form that looks genuinely ancient — evolution as palaeontology.

name: Lithonyx
concept: A massive revived fossil-predator whose carapace has grown thick enough to shrug off cave-ins; it swings its tail like a wrecking ball and its eyes glow with a faint ancient light.
visual: Large quadruped; thick ridged stone-white carapace with deep limestone-cream and grey layering; broad low head with two faintly glowing amber eyes; heavy armoured tail; primordial and formidable.
signature_idea: Ancient Force — a powerful physical attack drawing on the kin's aeons of preserved energy; never misses.
hook: The fossil that never should have woken up — ancient predator energy in a modern cave.

name: Oreling
concept: A dumpling-shaped cave-grub with a body fused to a piece of raw iron ore; it headbutts walls to eat mineral flakes, slowly growing heavier.
visual: Chubby grub-like body wrapped around a dark iron-ore lump; tiny arms, vestigial; rounded head with a wide flat mouth for scraping ore; small black eyes; warm grey-brown colouring.
hook: The ore-grub that looks like it's been bolted to a rock — endearing clumsiness.

name: Orebound
concept: A stocky bipedal kin that has grown up around its ore core; fists and elbows reinforced with raw iron protrusions, and new ore deposits form on its shoulders.
visual: Short biped with a barrel chest; iron-ore growth on both fists and elbows like natural knuckledusters; shoulder ore-knobs; dark grey skin with metallic flecks; small determined face.
hook: The mid-form that looks like it means business — ore-plated and ready to brawl.

name: Ferrolith
concept: A massive iron-ore golem whose body is now a dense interlock of stone and metal; each strike sends shockwaves through the mine tunnel walls.
visual: Imposing wide-shouldered biped; entire body studded with iron-ore protrusions and plates; massive stone fists each larger than a human torso; slow-burning orange eyes set deep in a craggy face; silhouette is pure power.
signature_idea: Ironclad Slam — a devastating physical move that ignores Defense-raising effects on the target.
hook: The iron golem that grew from a grub — the shock of scale makes its evolution line feel rewarding.

name: Sporeling
concept: A tiny mushroom-cap sprite native to Lowleaf Hollow. Its cap glows faintly and pulses when excited. It releases a gentle sleepy spore mist when threatened.
visual: Round mushroom-cap head (pale lavender with white spots), two stubby legs, tiny arms, big innocent eyes; fits in a cupped hand.
hook: Canon atlas kin — the iconic Lowleaf mushroom sprite every new player meets. Adorable first-catch energy.

name: Sporemid
concept: A taller, more confident mushroom-kin with a fully developed cap and a ring of satellite cap-growths around its torso. It exhales layered spore clouds with varied effects.
visual: Human-height mushroom form, broader cap with bioluminescent gill-lines underneath, satellite caps on its shoulders, dusty mauve-green coloured; stance is wide and assured.
hook: The bridge form — visibly more capable than Sporeling but with that same odd-cute mushroom energy.

name: Mycelarch
concept: The ancient lord of the Spore Grotto, a towering fungal entity whose underground mycelium network spans the entire Hollow. Its spores can read the emotional state of any creature nearby.
visual: Massive pillar-like mushroom body with many layered caps in deep indigo and midnight-green; trailing root-tendrils like a cloak; eyes gleam with dim amber light in shadow.
signature_idea: Mycelweb — status move that links all wild kin in the area to the user, mirroring status conditions
hook: The awe pay-off at the end of the Sporeling line — gentle sprout becomes an ancient, eerie fungal elder that secretly controls the whole forest floor.

name: Dewling
concept: A droplet-shaped seedling that lives in pools of forest dew. It is translucent, with a single seed-core visible inside its water-plant body.
visual: Teardrop body of pale green water-gel, a tiny brown seed core at its centre, thin tendrils as limbs, enormous shiny eyes; ethereally small.
hook: Impossibly tiny and translucent — a glowing dewdrop with eyes. Players love hatching something this small.

name: Poolfrond
concept: A lily-pad kin that glides on still forest pools. Its broad flat body floats on the surface while long submerged fronds trail below, sensing disturbances.
visual: Flat circular green body like a great lily-pad, smooth emerald top, pale root-fronds hanging down, periscope eyes on short stalks, small trailing flowers at the rim.
hook: Satisfying mid-form — clearly more capable than a dewdrop yet still serene and a little absurd; slides elegantly on water.

name: Tidalarch
concept: A great water-plant entity that spans a pool entirely, raising arching vine-bridges of woven kelp. Rumoured to be a single kin or many acting as one.
visual: Long arching serpentine plant form, dark teal body, many tributary fronds like trailing ribbons, lotus blossom crown of bioluminescent petals; fluid and enormous.
signature_idea: Surge Canopy — special move raising a curtain of pressurised water-and-vine that damages on entry
hook: The spectacular pool finale — starts as something you could hold in one hand and becomes something you walk under.

name: Barkhelm
concept: A sturdy tortoise-like creature whose shell is made of compressed bark and stone. It sleeps for weeks, growing new bark-rings like a tree.
visual: Tiny squat form, rounded bark-ring shell like a tree cross-section, four stubby rock-grey legs, a small snout peering out; looks like a living tree stump.
hook: A living tree-stump that turns out to be a baby — the double-take moment when it opens its eyes.

name: Stonebark
concept: A medium bark-golem that moves with deliberate slowness. Its bark-ring shell has mineralised completely, giving it near-impenetrable defences.
visual: Stocky upright tortoise-golem, concentric mineral-bark rings clearly visible on shell, mossy patches on flat back, two large stone-knuckled fists, calm half-lidded eyes.
hook: The middle of a great defensive line — growing visibly stronger while staying unhurried and serene.

name: Rootwarden
concept: An ancient bark-golem so old that saplings have begun growing from its back. It stands immobile as a boulder for centuries and only moves when the forest is threatened.
visual: Massive standing golem of layered stone-bark, a living forest growing from its shoulders (small ferns, mosses, a small sapling), deep carved-wood face half-hidden by roots, feet rooted into the ground.
signature_idea: Ancient Stand — ability: reduces all incoming damage by 20% while the user has not moved that turn
hook: A walking old-growth forest — the awe moment of realising the clearing you just walked through was a sleeping kin.

name: Glowsip
concept: A small nectar-moth larva that drinks bioluminescent glowmoss dew, storing liquid light in a translucent belly-sac. Its antennae drip soft cyan glow.
visual: Pale cream grub-body, faintly luminous belly like a nightlight, two feathery cyan antennae, soft compound eyes; round and huggable.
hook: starter candidate — glowing larva that looks like a living lantern; perfect for the lamplight aesthetic.

name: Lumournis
concept: A grand glowing moth whose wings are broad leaf-panels veined with bioluminescent channels. It radiates a healing aura that calms wild kin and soothes blight.
visual: Large moth form; four broad wings each shaped like a glowing leaf, veined in cyan and gold; soft downy body, feathered antennae, six slender legs; the whole silhouette looks like a living stained-glass window.
signature_idea: Dawnveil — special move that wraps an ally in luminous leaf-light, raising their special defence
hook: starter candidate — gorgeous moth finale that doubles as a mobile lantern; special tank role gives it defensive staying power, feels like a protector.

name: Fennlight
concept: A lithe glowing fern-serpent native to Lowleaf Hollow's bioluminescent undergrowth. Its body traces the pattern of fern fronds, and it darts through the dark emitting soft cyan pulses.
visual: Slender vine-serpent body, fern-leaf pattern along its sides that glows cyan, bright curious eyes, small frond-crown on its head; sinuous and quick.
hook: Canon atlas kin — the glowing fern-serpent, fast and magical. Hits Verdant/Light coverage and doubles as a moving lantern.

name: Fernlance
concept: A fully adult fern-serpent, now as long as a felled tree, wreathed in blazing bioluminescent fronds. It can launch focused beams of purified green-gold light. Revered by Lowleaf villagers as a forest guardian.
visual: Long undulating serpent, densely fringed with fern-fronds that blaze gold and cyan along their edges; head-crown has expanded into a full luminous halo; tail tapers to a glowing spike.
signature_idea: Frondbeam — special move, channels gathered forest-light into a single radiant strike
hook: The Lowleaf Hollow signature rare — seeing a Fernlance flowing through glowing ferns is the image on the east region's poster.

name: Riddlestone
concept: A sphinx-like cave construct that has formed naturally from layered sedimentary stone; its face is barely distinguishable from the rock, and it moves only rarely.
visual: Recumbent cat-lion shape carved entirely from layered sandstone bands in amber, cream, and grey; face is stylised and smooth like worn sculpture; heavy paws; eyes are two oval pieces of polished amber.
signature_idea: Stone Patience — greatly raises Special Defense at the cost of Speed; lore: it has waited in the mine for centuries.
hook: The cave-sphinx that barely moves — an atmosphere piece that's also a wall in battle.

name: Mycovast
concept: The apex kin of Spore Grotto — a vast, ancient fungal titan that has been growing through the rock of Glowmoss Deep for centuries, its mycelial network threading through both soil and stone until the two are indistinguishable in its body. The grotto it inhabits is as much part of it as its visible cap; remove the creature and the cave would slowly collapse. Mycovast communicates across its network in slow mineral resonance — a signal that takes hours but covers the whole eastern region. It is the oldest living thing in Vesperholm that isn't a star.
visual: An enormous mushroom-capped behemoth walking on six thick stone-threaded root-legs. The cap is deep earth-brown with bioluminescent Verdant spots in diamond-cyan and pale green. Beneath the cap hangs a fringe of glowing sporecurtain. The legs are stone-grey with thick mycelial cords wrapped around them like rope around pillars. The face is a flat, calm disc with two dim-glow eyes. At 64px it reads as a cave and a creature simultaneously.
signature_idea: Mycelial Surge — sends a pulse through its underground network that strikes every opponent with Verdant damage and inflicts the Rooted status (Speed halved, immune to forced switches) for two turns; the move that says the ground itself is the kin.
hook: The creature that makes players realise the whole grotto has been alive this whole time. A boss encounter with ecological horror charm.

name: Iceling
concept: A small, round ice-sprite no bigger than a fist that forms spontaneously wherever glacier ice meets air in a specific temperature band. It bounces off ice surfaces playfully, and its body is technically just very sophisticated ice — though Pale Vault philosophers debate this warmly over tea.
visual: Tiny, perfectly round body of translucent blue-white ice; a simple expressive face of two dark eyes and a small curved mouth pressed into the ice surface; stubby arms and legs of solid ice protrusions; bounces on the bottom like a rubber ball; the quintessential sprite form at 32px.
hook: The philosophical question of whether it's a kin or just very ambitious ice is the perfect dex-entry hook.

name: Glaceling
concept: A more developed ice-sprite that has gathered enough ambient ice to give itself a more defined, humanoid shape. It still bounces on rounded feet, but now manifests ice structures around itself — walls, bridges, steps — apparently decorating its territory. The structures always collapse after a day.
visual: Slightly taller, more defined sprite form; a distinct head on a short neck, arms with three-fingered ice hands; face is more expressive and detailed; occasionally surrounded by small floating ice-crystal fragments it is sculpting; mid-ground presence at 40px.
hook: The ice-sculpting-territory-decoration behaviour makes it feel like a small, weird artist — immediately lovable.

name: Frostholm
concept: The apex form of the ice-sprite lineage — a vast, ancient glacier-golem that has accumulated centuries of ice, starlight, and aurora-glow into a self-aware glacier monument. Frostholm is the living embodiment of the Pale Vault itself; legends say the glacier exists because Frostholm chose to sleep there, and it dreams the aurora into being. It is the Frost Constellation Warden — the Aurora Hollow's true guardian.
visual: Towering, broad-shouldered golem form sculpted from ancient blue-white glacial ice; its surface etched with centuries of swirling aurora-pattern carvings; the face is serene, simple, and impossibly old; aurora-light leaks from the carved lines across its body; at 48px it fills the frame completely, a walking glacier-face.
signature_idea: Aurora Sanctum — a Light/Frost special move that raises both the user's special defence and special attack and launches an aurora-wave dealing moderate damage to all opponents
hook: The Frost Constellation Warden — the glacier guardian that dreams the aurora. Finding it in Aurora Hollow is the north's equivalent of the story's whole promise.

name: Geolace
concept: A small, crystalline geode-crab whose outer shell is a natural geode split down the middle, exposing a cavity glittering with frost-crystal druzy. It scuttles along glacier crevasse walls and eats mineral-rich ice. Its shell grows a new layer of crystals each winter.
visual: Squat crab-like form; body is literally a split geode half — rough dark mineral exterior with a spectacular glittering interior visible from above; six short spiky legs; two crystal-tipped pincer claws; unique silhouette readable at 32px as a lumpy oval with jutting points.
hook: A geode as a crab-shell is visually unlike anything else — the glittering interior is a treasure chest on legs.

name: Geodrake
concept: A mid-sized geode-armoured crustacean that has grown additional crystal growths along its carapace. The crystals serve as both armour and weapon — Geodrake can launch crystal shards by flexing its shell. Deep glacier miners warn that Geodrake territories are marked by shattered walls.
visual: Wider, heavier crustacean form; carapace now densely covered in faceted crystal protrusions in purple-to-ice-blue; thicker claws tipped with drill-point crystal spires; mid-form still crablike but clearly larger and more weaponised at 40px.
hook: The growing crystal-armour escalation makes each stage feel like an upgrade.

name: Vaultclaw
concept: A colossal glacier-hermit whose geode shell has become a literal ice-cave it carries. The crystal interior is now large enough to shelter small kin in blizzards — some say Frostkit families nest inside willing Vaultclaw shells. Its claws can carve new passages through glacier ice.
visual: Large, powerful crustacean body; the carapace is now a massive dome of geode and ice-crystal formations, towering above the body; huge armoured claws; a walking glacier-cave silhouette — dramatic and distinctive at 48px, dominated by the crystal dome above.
signature_idea: Geovault — a Stone/Frost physical move that also raises the user's defence as crystal armour hardens further
hook: A walking crystal cave that shelters other kin — the ecological and visual storytelling is irresistible.

name: Chillpip
concept: A plump little snow-chick with a soft fluff coat of powder-white down. The ice crystals in its down scatter light into tiny rainbows. It tumbles more than walks and cannot yet fly, but its cheerful chirping keeps glacier travellers' spirits up.
visual: Round, egg-shaped chick body; big round head with a tiny curved beak; oversized fluffy wings it can't quite fold correctly; powder-white with a pale sky-blue belly; crystal glints in the down; one of the roundest, chubbiest silhouettes in the roster at 32px.
hook: Maximum chick-fluff energy — the crystal-scatter rainbow detail is a small treasure that rewards close attention.

name: Crystarn
concept: A half-grown snow-bird that has shed its chick-fluff for proper iridescent feathers underlaid with tiny ice-crystal filaments. It can now fly, and its wingbeats scatter prismatic ice-dust. Flocks of Crystarn spiral above the glacier in breathtaking chevrons.
visual: Medium bird form; streamlined body with swept-back tail feathers tipped in crystal points; feathers shaded blue-white to silver; wing edges fringed with tiny icicle spurs; alert amber eye with a diamond highlight; clean aerodynamic silhouette at 40px.
hook: The transformation from helpless chick-ball to elegant crystal-feathered flier is the core kindling-joy moment.

name: Glacitern
concept: A fully matured blizzard-tern of startling size. Its wings generate localised ice-laced gales, and it dives at speed to shatter thin ice with its crystallised bill. Glacier pilots say Glacitern dives are visible from three valleys away — a diving streak of white and blue lightning.
visual: Large seabird-inspired form; sharply swept wings with serrated trailing-edge icicle spurs; elongated blade-like bill crackling with frost and static; body sleek from head to forked tail; blue-grey body, white underside, lightning-blue wing tips; fierce predator silhouette at 48px.
signature_idea: Icestrike Dive — a priority physical move that does bonus damage to grounded targets
hook: The evolution from round snow-chick to diving blizzard predator spans the full emotional register of creature design.

name: Snowcune
concept: A playful little snow-hare with oversized feet perfect for bounding across deep powder. Its fur coat is two layers: the outer is a coarse frost-white that repels snow, and the inner radiates a faint warmth. It moves in bounding arcs, always landing softly, leaving only the faintest impressions.
visual: Classic hare silhouette; very large hind feet, long upright ears with pale icy tips; powder-white fur with a subtle blue-grey shadow tone; round body, small face with a tiny dark nose; speed-suggesting long-legged pose at 32px.
hook: The oversized snow-hare feet are immediately charming; the dual-coat detail rewards a player who reads the dex entry.

name: Blizzrhare
concept: A mid-form hare that has shed its soft pup-coat for sleek winter fur hardened into wind-channelling ridges. It runs so fast it generates a localised snow-vortex around itself. Pale Vault villagers call these small spinning snow-devils 'hare-ghosts.'
visual: Taller, leaner hare form; fur now has aerodynamic ridge-lines down the flanks; elongated ears swept back; narrow, aerodynamic face; the overall silhouette reads like a sprinter frozen at the instant of launch at 40px.
hook: The hare-ghost snow-vortex detail is the kind of world-building kids pass on to friends.

name: Vortexlope
concept: A blizzard-speed hare of remarkable size whose constant motion generates a persistent personal blizzard. It never truly stops moving — even resting, it trembles with contained velocity. When it runs at full speed the snow-vortex behind it is visible for kilometres. The fastest kin native to the north.
visual: Tall, long-limbed, powerful hare; fur has crystallised into blade-like ridge-plates along the entire back and limbs; swept-back ears now rigid and tapered like antennae; a trailing blizzard-halo always swirls behind it; dynamic forward-leaning pose at 48px.
signature_idea: Blizzardbreak — the highest-speed-tier Frost special attack, power scales with the user's speed advantage over the target
hook: The glass-cannon blizzard-hare is an archetype-fulfilling powerhouse with strong visual storytelling in its silhouette alone.

name: Hushvole
concept: A small, round snow-vole that buries itself just below the glacier surface and pops up to startle travellers. Its breath muffles all nearby sounds — experienced Pale Vault guides say you've entered Hushvole territory when your footsteps go quiet.
visual: Chubby, button-eyed little rodent; pale grey-white fur with a faint blue undertone; stubby frost-tipped claws; oversized round ears; a perfectly spherical snow-dusted silhouette at 32px that reads as one compact ball.
hook: The sound-muffling concept is evocative and spooky in a cosy way — the glacier going silent around you.

name: Hushbore
concept: A mid-sized burrowing rodent with thickened ice-plated shoulder pads from tunnelling through frozen earth. The silence aura has intensified — within a short radius, even battle cries and ability sounds are absorbed. It uses this quiet as both hunting cover and territory defence.
visual: Stout, compact rodent; broad shoulders covered in layered ice-plate armour; long digging claws with ice-crystal edges; flattened wide head; small round eyes; a side-profile silhouette with strong armour shapes readable at 40px.
hook: The ice-armour shoulder transformation makes the 'quiet predator' concept click into an intimidating mid-form.

name: Stillwarden
concept: A massive glacier-burrower whose silence aura has expanded to blanket entire cave systems. Its back has erupted into a ridge of obsidian-black ice spurs. Where Stillwarden rests, no sound exists — not wind, not water, not other kin. Hushfrost Pass travellers whisper that silence means it is near.
visual: Large, powerfully built rodent body; spinal ridge of black ice-crystal spurs along the back; thick neck, wide flat head with deep-set ice-pale eyes; slate-dark colouration on the upper body, pale beneath; silhouette dominated by the spine ridge at 48px.
signature_idea: Deadsilence — a Dark/Frost status move that prevents the target using sound-based or vocal moves for 3 turns
hook: The transition from cute snow-vole to something that makes silence feel ominous is a perfect awe-curve story.

name: Prismcub
concept: A round-eared ice-bear cub of the Pale Vault Glacier whose fur is threaded with prism-crystal filaments; it tumbles through snowdrifts leaving miniature rainbow trails in its wake.
visual: Chubby bear cub with snow-white fur laced with fine crystal-threads that catch light in rainbow refractions; a big round nose; small triangular ears; wide trusting eyes; stumbles more than walks; irresistibly cute at 16px.
hook: A glittery rainbow bear cub — the purest concentrated 'kids will love this' design in the batch.

name: Prismantus
concept: A fully grown glacier-bear whose crystal-fur has solidified into great diamond-hard prism-plates; it slams opponents with rainbow-refracting claws and can freeze the air around it into a blinding prismatic storm.
visual: Large polar bear; thick layered prism-crystal plates replace the fur on its shoulders and back like natural armour; claws are translucent crystal-blade; fur in gaps is still white; dignified and powerful; beautiful and formidable at 64px.
signature_idea: Prism Slam — physical Light-type move that deals damage and has a 30% chance to inflict Dazzle (foe accuracy -2) from the rainbow flash; boosted by ice terrain.
hook: The wholesome cute cub grows into a crystal-armoured powerhouse — a satisfying arc for players who raised it.

name: Sparrowcaw
concept: A scrappy little terrace-sparrow that pecks spark-producing pyrite from the cliff walls and stores the flint-chips under its wing to use as a crude battery during battle.
visual: Compact passerine bird, rust-brown and dark slate-blue plumage, a puffed chest crossed by a small leather-look pouch of flint pebbles, tiny defiant eyes; cheeky and small at 32px.
hook: A sparrow that carries flint to start fires — more resourceful than it looks.

name: Flintbeak
concept: A mid-stage strike-bird whose beak has hardened into a flint-edged chisel that sparks on every strike, and whose charge builds faster the more consecutive hits it lands.
visual: Lean raptor, dark charcoal and slate-blue feathers, a dramatically elongated flint-edged beak that cracks sparks on impact, talons wrapped in static; focused aggression at 48px.
hook: The beak-as-thunderstrike concept makes every hit feel satisfying — a natural woodpecker of electricity.

name: Strikeaven
concept: The apex flint-raven: a large, sleek storm-bird whose entire beak has become a solid static-discharge rod that releases a plasma bolt on each strike; the more it attacks, the stronger each blow.
visual: Tall raven silhouette, ink-black feathers with electric-blue iridescence, a long bladed beak crackling with a continuous spark-arc, wingtips trailing static filaments; sleek and lethal at 64px.
signature_idea: Momentum Strike — deals damage that scales with each consecutive hit in a chain; chain resets if it misses or is swapped out.
hook: Each hit charges it more — a slow build into an unstoppable momentum that rewards not retreating.

name: Cirruff
concept: A cloud-fluff pup born inside a high cirrus cloud; its fur is made of compressed cloud-stuff that crackles with soft static, and it glows faintly gold at the edges when happy.
visual: Plump round pup, fluffy white cloud-textured fur that puffs out at the paws and tail, faint gold edge-glow, two bright eyes and a tiny static-spark nose; irresistibly soft at 32px.
hook: A puppy made of cloud-fluff that sparkles — you'll want to hug it even knowing it shocks back.

name: Nimbruff
concept: The cloud-pup's fur has densified into cumulonimbus wool that flashes with internal lightning; it's cheerful but the gold-edged static halos around its body scatter light in every direction.
visual: Larger barrel-chested dog, dense grey-and-white thundercloud fur, a visible inner-glow pulsing electric-gold, long windswept ears, silver underbelly; bold presence at 48px.
hook: A golden glow behind storm-grey clouds — every battle with it feels like watching a storm roll in.

name: Cumulance
concept: The cloud-hound's final form — a great silver-and-gold stormhound whose body is a living thunderhead, radiating soft dawn-light even through the Galehigh dusk.
visual: Majestic hound silhouette, body a sculptured mass of dark-silver cloud, a blazing golden core visible through the chest, mane of vertical lightning-columns, four cloud-pad legs leaving gold hoofprints; awe-inspiring at 64px.
signature_idea: Goldstrike — a special move that targets both opposing Sp.Def and applies a Light-type radiance debuff.
hook: A cloud-puppy grew into the living heart of a thunderstorm lit from within by golden light.

name: Hailwhirr
concept: A small blizzard-wasp native to the high passes above Galehigh, spinning frost crystals from its wing-tips as it spirals in updrafts; its sting is numbing cold rather than venom.
visual: Compact wasp silhouette, ice-blue and silver banding, wings that frost the air visibly as they beat, a sharp pointed abdomen tipped with a pale blue crystal stinger; crisp geometry at 32px.
hook: A winter wasp that spins ice from its wings — pretty until it stings.

name: Glacewing
concept: A mid-stage blizzard-wasp that has grown compound crystal eyes and whose wingbeats create a spiralling vortex of hail shards around its flight path.
visual: Larger angular wasp, wide iridescent frost-blue compound eyes, four wings edged with jagged ice-crystal trim, abdomen trailing a coil of hail particles; dynamic danger at 48px.
hook: The ice-vortex around it makes it look like it's already mid-attack even while resting.

name: Frigalance
concept: The apex blizzard-wasp: a slender, blade-like creature that moves through lightning-charged blizzards with total ease, delivering shots of frozen plasma that combine electric and ice damage.
visual: Long aerodynamic wasp silhouette, pale near-white with deep azure markings, a pair of blade-like crystal wings, four foreleg-lances each tipped with frozen lightning; cold elegance at 64px.
signature_idea: Sleet Lance — a special Storm/Frost hybrid move with a chance to both paralyse and freeze.
hook: Beautiful, lethal, and utterly cold — the sky's version of a thrown spear.

name: Thrumvane
concept: A small, plump kin whose tail spins like a weathervane in wind; the rotation charges a static field around its body and it uses that stored charge to jam opponents' moves.
visual: Chubby oval body, stubby limbs, a broad four-blade tail that spins freely, grey-blue fur with yellow static-spark highlights at the vane tips; cute windmill shape at 32px.
hook: A living windmill with a static personality — every time it spins faster, sparks fly.

name: Thrumble
concept: A mid-stage kin whose vane-tail has grown wider and generates a continuous hum of low-frequency electricity that muddles the senses of nearby opponents.
visual: Sleeker torso, elongated limbs, tail now a six-blade fan crackling at each tip with pale yellow sparks, a thin electric halo around the body's outline; reads as actively buzzing at 48px.
hook: You can feel the hum before you see it — that constant low vibration is deeply unsettling to fight.

name: Vortavane
concept: The apex vane-beast: a tall, regal kin whose entire dorsal spine has become a bank of spinning turbine-blades, generating a tornado-like static field that blinds and staggers opponents.
visual: Upright digitigrade silhouette, dark storm-grey coat, a full spine-ridge of spinning vane-blades each trailing a spark arc, crackling eye-markings that pulse in sync with the vanes; imposing at 64px.
signature_idea: Stormfield — creates a persistent static field that has a chance to paralyse any kin that uses a contact move.
hook: The windmill grew into a roaring turbine — impossible to touch without getting shocked.

name: Squallox
concept: A gust-fox kit born on the exposed upper terraces, its tail a perpetual blurred blur of motion that keeps it airborne a fraction of a second longer than it should be able to stay.
visual: Compact kit silhouette, deep azure-blue fur, four white paws, a tall pointed ear-fan on each side, a blurred fan-tail of multiple stacked ghost images; looks like it's still mid-run at 32px.
hook: The fox whose tail moves so fast it looks like it has three tails at once — speed incarnate.

name: Galefox
concept: A sleek mid-stage gust-fox who now runs so fast it creates a visible bow-wave of compressed air ahead of it; close-combat opponents are pushed back by the pressure wave before it even strikes.
visual: Lithe medium fox silhouette, deep storm-blue body fading to pale silver at the throat and belly, a single bold tail crackling at the tip, wind-distortion ripples around the paws; pure velocity at 48px.
hook: The bow-wave around it makes the ground look like it's peeling back ahead of every sprint.

name: Tempestail
concept: The apex gust-fox — a lithe, white-silver predator whose tail is now a visible thunderstorm compressed into a spinning cylinder; at full sprint its approach sounds like a breaking gale.
visual: Elegant large fox silhouette, white-silver fur with storm-blue markings, a spiralling tornado-tail that crackles with visible charge, twin ear-fins swept back; the apex of aerodynamic at 64px.
signature_idea: Gale Rush — a high-priority physical move that doubles in power if used first in a turn.
hook: The little kit that couldn't quite leave the ground became this magnificent silver storm-predator.

name: Gilpaw
concept: A small leonine cub whose coat has mineralised into gilded stone plates, soaking up ambient Solar energy from the Solarium's ruins. It naps in sun-warmed arches and radiates stored heat.
visual: Compact lion-cub silhouette; body covered in smooth gold-toned stone plates like overlapping scales; four stubby paws with amber glowing pawpads; round face with bright amber eyes; cute and sturdy at 32px.
hook: A golden armoured cub — solid, warm, and endearing, like a sun-kissed statue that decided to yawn.

name: Goldmane
concept: A gilded stone lion whose mane has erupted into a crown of solar-flare spines; it stores massive amounts of daylight in its dense mineral body and releases it in searing physical charges.
visual: Large, imposing lion silhouette with a barrel chest; mane replaced by radiant gold-stone spines fanning outward like sun rays; body plates carved with spiral solar motifs; heavy paws leave glowing prints; dramatic at 64px.
signature_idea: Solarite Charge — physical Solar move that scales with the user's Defense stat
hook: A gilded stone lion whose mane is made of sunlight — the apex predator of the Solarium, and unmistakably a trophy.

name: Snoozlet
concept: A drowsy round moon-sheep that drifts half-awake through the Nightreach highlands, trailing softly glowing wool-tufts that carry faint dream-motes wherever they float.
visual: Plump round sheep body in pale cream-blue, half-closed crescent eyes, small crescent-moon horns, fluffy wool with faint silver-blue glow-wisps drifting off it; maximally round silhouette at 32px.
hook: The sleepiest, softest sheep in the world — just looking at it makes you yawn.

name: Drowshorn
concept: A mid-sized dream-ram whose crescent horns have grown into proper moon-arcs that hum with soporific resonance; anything caught near it during its slow, dreamy patrol gradually loses focus.
visual: Stocky ram silhouette, deep slate-blue wool, full crescent moon-arc horns lit with cool silver, half-lidded star-pupils, trail of floating dream-motes; calm and commanding at 48px.
hook: Peaceful but quietly menacing — it doesn't fight you, it just makes you forget you wanted to.

name: Lunarbel
concept: A great moon-ram whose wool has become a cascade of solidified moonlight, each strand a fine thread of pure silver-white luminescence. It stands watch over sleeping kin, radiating a calming aura that suppresses nightmares.
visual: Large broad-shouldered ram, glowing silver-white flowing wool, full moon-disk framed between sweeping horn-arcs, radiant star-pupils, soft halo aura; majestic and otherworldly at 64px.
signature_idea: Dream Warden — raises own Sp. Def and inflicts sleep on a switched-in opponent
hook: A sky-sheep made of moonlight, standing guard in the dark — the most reassuring sight in the night highlands.

name: Solunet
concept: A little moon-tide sprite shaped like a water-drop with a crescent inside; it skips across wet rooftops in Nightreach when the moon is high, riding the silver reflections of puddles.
visual: Teardrop body, translucent cool-blue with a glowing silver crescent suspended inside, tiny stub feet, round hopeful eyes; simple and lovely at 32px.
hook: A moon caught inside a raindrop — the most delicate little thing, made of two beautiful things at once.

name: Tidalune
concept: A moon-tide sprite that has gathered enough water to form a proper fluid body, hovering in a rotating sphere of water illuminated from within by crescent-light. It pulls at opponents with slow tidal forces.
visual: Sphere of slowly rotating pale blue water with a luminous crescent core, small fine-featured face at the water surface, trailing water-arc tails; elegant floating orb at 48px.
hook: A moon living inside a sphere of water — hypnotic to watch and quietly threatening.

name: Lunaquell
concept: The tide-moon spirit in its full form: a vast oceanic omen-being whose water-sphere has grown to contain a miniature tidal sea, with a full moon disc blazing at its heart. It calls tides even in landlocked places.
visual: Large hovering sphere of churning dark ocean water, full moon-disc blazing silver at the exact centre, visible wave-turbulence inside the sphere, trailing ocean-mist arcs; vast and awe-inspiring at 64px.
signature_idea: Neap Call — calls a tidal wave that hits all opponents and sharply lowers their Speed
hook: It carries the whole ocean in a sphere and a moon inside that — one of Vesperholm's most staggering final forms.

name: Spirlet
concept: A tiny night-spirit sprite that looks like a faint crescent cut from silver tissue paper; it drifts on the cold night air above Nightreach Observatory, emitting a soft high hum that unsettles nearby kin.
visual: Simple crescent-moon silhouette form, translucent silver-white body, two tiny round eyes, a faint shimmer trail; minimal and eerie at 32px.
hook: A tiny sliver of moon given life — impossibly delicate and just a little unsettling.

name: Nightwraith
concept: A mid-stage moon-spirit that has grown a veil of dark mist around its crescent core; it whispers in a frequency that plants doubt and unease in the minds of those who hear it.
visual: Hovering crescent-core wrapped in a flowing ink-and-silver mist veil, two luminous crescent eyes, long wispy trailing arms of mist; spectral and unnerving at 48px.
hook: The cute crescent sprite grew into a whispering dusk-wraith — one of those rare mid-stages worth using in its own right.

name: Omenire
concept: A towering eclipse-spirit whose crescent core is now fully ringed by a disc of null-dark; it embodies the omen of a total eclipse — foreboding, still, and able to drain conviction from anyone who meets its gaze.
visual: Tall spectral silhouette, a full solar-eclipse disc at the chest (silver rim, ink-dark centre), long ink-mist arms reaching wide, crescent crown of pale fire atop the head; dramatic and eerie at 64px.
signature_idea: Eclipse Omen — lowers all opponent stats by one stage simultaneously; usable once
hook: The crescent grew into an eclipse — the omen of everything going still before something terrible or wonderful happens.

name: Sunsprout
concept: A compact sun-flower bulb kin that drifted into the Sunken Solarium long ago and absorbed stored daylight through its roots, giving its petals a warm inner glow even in perpetual dusk.
visual: Squat round green bulb body, four petals splayed around an amber-glowing centre disc, tiny leafy feet; warm gold halo at the petal tips; reads as a bright flower silhouette at 32px.
hook: A cheerful sun-petal kin glowing from the inside — the first Solar kin a player will meet, and it feels like holding a tiny lantern.

name: Solvyne
concept: A tall vine-wreathed sun-fae whose open flower-crown channels stored daylight into its spiral tendrils, healing wounds with warm radiance.
visual: Slender humanoid silhouette wrapped in glowing vines; broad open sunflower crown framing the face; amber-gold light streams from the petal edges; reads as a confident mid-stage at 48px.
hook: It tends to wounded kin in the Solarium ruins like a guardian — an ally that glows warmer the more it trusts you.

name: Auravane
concept: A great solar-vine sovereign whose canopy of golden petals releases stored daylight in wide solar pulses, sustaining the last living flora of the Sunken Solarium.
visual: Large, stately kin with a thick trunk-like lower body anchored by root-feet; eight grand petals fan outward like a sun-disc crown, each veined with liquid gold light; dominant, warm silhouette at 64px.
signature_idea: Solar Bloom — releases a pulse of stored light that heals self and chips all foes with Solar damage
hook: The undisputed caretaker of the Solarium — a radiant tree-creature that makes every battle feel like fighting a living sunrise.

name: Helibud
concept: A rolling solar-seed that bounced free of the Solarium's golden arches; it spins constantly to charge itself with stored daylight, emitting a faint hum and a warm amber glow.
visual: Smooth orb-shaped kin, deep amber with eight radial sun-ray notches carved around its equator; two small leaf-wing nubs; single glowing eye; reads cleanly as a spinning ball at 32px.
hook: Endlessly spinning and humming with stored warmth — a living solar toy kids will want to roll everywhere.

name: Helicore
concept: A solar orb kin that has cracked open slightly to reveal a molten amber core; the spinning has accelerated so much that it now hovers just above the ground, leaving a faint scorch ring where it rests.
visual: Slightly larger orb with a glowing fracture line around the equator revealing golden inner light; a halo of heat distortion shimmers above it; sun-ray notches are now clearly defined ridges; bold at 48px.
hook: A spinning engine of stored sunlight on the verge of breaking open — it feels genuinely powerful and a little dangerous.

name: Helithorn
concept: The fully awakened solar apex — the outer shell has burst open into a ring of eight radiant thorn-spokes orbiting a blazing amber core, discharging stored daylight in flares that scorch the air around it.
visual: Central blazing amber sphere orbited by eight angled spike-shards like a sun diagram; the whole assembly rotates slowly; corona of golden light bleeds outward; unmistakable, awe-defining at 64px.
signature_idea: Sunburst Crown — charges one turn then releases all stored light in a radial explosion hitting every foe
hook: The most purely Solar thing in the dex — a miniature sun wearing its own corona, rotating in midair. Jaw-dropping on first encounter.

name: Dawnfawn
concept: A young sun-stag fawn whose antler stubs are flowering sun-vine shoots; it drinks stored daylight through the vines and runs so fast it leaves a brief trail of golden motes on the overgrown Sunvault Climb terraces.
visual: Slender fawn silhouette; cream-gold coat with amber dappling; two short antler stubs sprouting bright yellow sun-flowers; four long sprinting legs; tail is a tuft of glowing seedfluff; lively and leggy at 40px.
hook: A golden fawn trailing flower-petals as it runs — fleet-footed, joyful, and impossible not to chase.

name: Sunstag
concept: A great dawn-stag with a full crown of antlers wreathed in blooming sun-vine flowers; each tine blazes with stored Solar energy, and its passage across the terraces floods the path with warm golden light.
visual: Tall, proud stag silhouette; twelve-point antler crown flowering at every tip with radiant amber blooms; broad chest, powerful haunches; coat shifts from deep amber at the hooves to pale gold at the neck; commanding at 64px.
signature_idea: Crown Gallop — Physical Solar/Verdant combo charge that deals both type damage and scatters healing petals
hook: A magnificent blazing stag with antlers in full flower — the single most impressive creature on the Sunvault Climb, an instant collector's trophy.

name: Solray
concept: A flat, disc-shaped solar ray-fish that drifts through the Solarium's flooded halls like a living sunbeam, its body fully translucent except for a golden radial pattern of stored-light cells.
visual: Flat circular body, translucent amber with a golden starburst vein-pattern at the centre; six thin trailing rays fanning back like a sun's corona; floats serenely; elegant at 40px.
hook: A solar ray floating in dark water like a living stained-glass window — beautiful and alien.

name: Solreach
concept: A vast solar disc-ray that has doubled in size and brightness, now trailing twelve long luminous rays that each end in a focused point of concentrated daylight capable of cutting stone.
visual: Wide disc silhouette, now with a visible central eye that pulses golden; twelve long ray-trails fan out in all directions, each tipped with a bright point; at 64px it fills the frame like a living sun glyph.
signature_idea: Ray Convergence — twelve rays briefly merge into a single concentrated beam for massive Solar damage
hook: A creature shaped exactly like the sun — ancient, enormous, and utterly unmatched in the flooded dark.

name: Petalune
concept: A quick frost-moth with wings patterned in delicate ice-crystal mandalas that catch moonlight and scatter it as prismatic cold sparks. It flits between the telescope domes leaving frosty petal-impressions on the glass.
visual: Slender moth silhouette, pale blue-white body, broad wings with intricate frost-mandala patterning in silver and ice-blue, long tapered antennae; delicate and swift at 48px.
hook: A moth made of moonlit frost — beautiful, fleeting, and endlessly collectible.

name: Crystalune
concept: A large moon-moth whose wings have crystallised into translucent ice-panels etched with star-map engravings. It navigates by the stars with uncanny precision and can flash-freeze the air around it.
visual: Wide-span moth, deep midnight-blue body, enormous translucent ice-panel wings with fine star-chart etchings glowing silver, trail of ice-crystal motes; grand and luminous at 64px.
signature_idea: Starmap Veil — sets a two-turn Frost field that slows all grounded opponents
hook: Its wings are literally a star atlas carved in ice — the most visually stunning moth in Vesperholm.

name: Lunveil
concept: A silvery curtain-moth near the Nightreach Observatory, its wings folded like shut eyelids; at night it opens them to reveal glowing Lunar-map markings that disorient rivals.
visual: Mid-sized moth with broad flat wings folded at rest; wings are dove-grey with eyes-shut markings on the outer face, but when spread reveal detailed silver-on-indigo moonphase maps; antennae tipped with small white orbs; elegant and mysterious at 32px.
hook: Two completely different wing faces — the shy closed moth and the revelatory open moth — give it a double life kids will find fascinating.

name: Lunvane
concept: A vast lunar-herald moth whose wing-span casts a moon-shadow over the battlefield; it confuses, charms, and sleep-dusts opponents with an otherworldly calm that feels like drifting off to sleep under open skies.
visual: Enormous wingspan; wings are deep midnight-blue with silver crescent and star-chart patterns that shift slowly; a long graceful body of silver-white; two large feathery antennae like plumes; hovers silently; presence fills the battle frame at 64px.
signature_idea: Moonfall Curtain — inflicts Sleep on one target with 90% accuracy; if the target is already Confused, inflicts Sleep automatically and also leaves a 3-turn Drowsy field that slows all grounded foes.
hook: The moon made into a moth — one of the most atmospheric kin in the game; collectors will feel privileged to own one.

name: Solarmourn
concept: The luminous anchor of the Solar Constellation, a great heron-phoenix whose plumage is the last fragment of stored daylight in the Sunken Solarium. It doesn't burn — it glows with the warm memory of sunlight, a diffuse gold that makes everything it stands beside look briefly like afternoon. Lucan Pyre found it roosting in the solarium's highest dry arch, a decade ago, and has kept its presence secret, because he was afraid. It embodies not the heat of the sun but the feeling of warmth remembered — a comfort, not a weapon.
visual: Tall, elegant heron-phoenix with long sweeping tail feathers that trail behind like a train. Plumage in warm gold and honey-amber, edged with faint diamond-cyan light. The chest and neck are pale as bone-white parchment. One wing is slightly shorter — an old wound that never quite healed. Eyes are deep amber, warm and patient. The silhouette is all grace and faded glory.
signature_idea: Last Warm Day — floods the battlefield with stored solar warmth, raising all allies' Speed and Special Attack for three turns while giving the user near-perfect priority on its next move; a pivot move built from memory.
hook: The sorrowful beauty of something magnificent that has endured too long alone. Players who battle this one in the Solarium will feel the whole Vesperholm mood in one encounter.

name: Dawnwatcher
concept: The sub-legendary apex of the Lunar constellation — a great celestial heron of crystallised moonlight and captured starfire, said to stand vigil at the exact moment between night and dawn. Nightreach astronomers built the observatory to watch for it. Lunar/Light Constellation Warden.
visual: Tall elegant heron silhouette, body formed of layered plates of translucent crystalline moonlight, long neck and crest trailing silver-white starfire, vast wings spanning full starfield patterns, a single blazing star-eye; monumentally graceful at 64px.
signature_idea: Starfire Vigil — marks one opponent for true damage every turn for 3 turns while raising own defenses
hook: The heron that watches the sky so dawn can come — the Warden of the Lunar constellation, and the reason Nightreach Observatory exists at all.

name: Heliovast
concept: Sealed inside the Helia Vault — a reliquary off Sunvault Climb whose door can only be unlocked by Sunsketch — Heliovast is the most concentrated pocket of stored sunlight in Vesperholm. It resembles a vast solar-ray fish, drifting through the sealed interior of the vault in a self-sustaining solar current. The vault was built specifically to contain it safely, because its presence causes nearby plants to bloom years ahead of schedule and dormant seeds from other regions to germinate in the stone cracks. It doesn't fight to harm — it radiates, and the radiation is overwhelming.
visual: A great disc-bodied ray with an enormous central solar-eye at the front face, surrounded by radiating fin-rays like a living sun diagram. The body is deep gold with white-hot veins. The fin-rays are translucent amber, trailing fading light halos at their tips. The eye is an intense white-core disc. Even at idle, the battle background behind it yellows. The silhouette at 64px is a sun — because it is one.
signature_idea: Solar Surge — charges for one turn building internal solar pressure, then releases a total-immolation Special strike that deals Solar damage to all opponents and leaves a persistent Sunfield that boosts Solar-type attacks for three turns.
hook: The one kin where catching it makes the battle screen itself change colour. Players will remember exactly where they first saw it.

name: Helixia
concept: The Helia Vault's guardian: a great solar apex kin shaped like a living orrery, its body a central amber core ringed by three concentric hoops of golden light that rotate at different speeds, releasing precision solar lances.
visual: Spherical amber core roughly lion-headed, with three glowing golden rings orbiting at different angles (like an armillary sphere); each ring is studded with small radiant nodes; the whole structure rotates; breathtaking at 64px.
signature_idea: Orrery Lance — fires a targeted beam from each ring simultaneously, three hits of Solar damage in one turn
hook: A living golden armillary sphere — the awe-pinnacle of the Solar type and the centrepiece of Helia Vault. Nothing else in the dex looks anything like it.

name: Lunaveil
concept: The luminous anchor of the Lunar Constellation, a silken serpent-moth of impossible size — its wingspan covers the Nightreach Observatory's dome when it alights. Nessa Cole has been tracking its orbital path through the sky for years without knowing what it was. It navigates by the Lunar star alone; when that star was dimmed, it circled the Observatory for months, lost, and finally settled behind the great lens. Its wings are the night sky itself, each scale a pinprick of cold blue starlight. When it moves, it leaves a fading trail of lunar dust.
visual: Vast serpent-body with two enormous moth-wings, each wing a deep night-blue scattered with hundreds of cold diamond-cyan star-point scales. The serpent body is dark as ink with a faint silver-blue iridescence. The head is moth-like with long feeler-antennae tipped with cold silver sparks. In the night-blue palette of the Observatory, it is nearly invisible until it moves.
signature_idea: Lunar Drift — phases partially out of material existence, making the user immune to all moves for one turn and then slamming back into reality with a high-Speed special strike that always moves first.
hook: The night sky as a creature. Anyone who watches its entrance animation will screenshot it immediately.

name: Flutterwane
concept: A tiny will-o'-wisp no bigger than a fist, its glow cycling between warm amber and drained grey as if the Hollowing pulls at something it refuses to release. It blinks in and out of visibility like a guttering candle.
